description: Calculates indicative UAE Employer of Record costs from pay inputs in AED. Returns the same upfront funding, monthly payment, and Year 1 and Year 2 budgets as the Cosec website calculator. Final terms are confirmed in a quotation.

allowance.description: Monthly fixed allowances in AED. Defaults to 0. Used as the default for each team member that omits it.

applyVat.description: Whether 5% VAT on the management fee is included. Defaults to true, matching the calculator.

basic.description: Monthly basic salary in AED. Required unless team is set.

changeOfStatus.description: Whether a change of status is required. Defaults to true, matching the calculator.

commission.description: Monthly commission in AED. Optional. Defaults to 0. Does not increase the management fee or the gratuity reserve.

currency.description: Display currency for the totals. Inputs stay in AED. Defaults to AED. USD, GBP and EUR use a Frankfurter AED rate.

employees.description: Number of employees on a shared pay package. Defaults to 1. Mutually exclusive with team.

insurance.description: Annual premium in AED for a single pay package, or the default for team members that omit it. A missing or null value uses the planning allowance. 0 means no premium.

team.description: One object per employee. Each entry is one person. A headcount on an entry is rejected.

changeOfStatus.description: Same choice as status. Defaults to true.

insurance.description: Annual medical insurance premium in AED. A missing or null value uses the planning allowance. 0 means no premium.

insurancePayment.description: Defaults to annual. Monthly payment puts the first instalment upfront and the rest in the monthly figure.

medical.description: Medical test and Emirates ID. Defaults to standard.

status.description: yes when a change of status is required.
